summary_en: PBR 0.6x. Policy: stable base dividend + opportunistic buyback during market stress. Current buyback (¥400M, 50,000 shares max, initiated June 2026) ongoing. Growth capex ¥4.5B (new factory, ~¥1.5B subsidy-funded) to boost productivity and capacity. Balance sheet focus on financial soundness and long-term value creation.
title_en: Response to Realizing Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Stock Price
translation_en_brief:
On 7 August 2026, Kyowa Kogyo's board approved a capital-allocation framework responding to TSE guidance and the company's PBR trading at 0.6x. The announcement acknowledges the company has maintained a strong balance sheet and cash position but had not clearly communicated how these assets will be deployed for growth and shareholder returns.

The company commits to stable base dividends while executing opportunistic share buybacks keyed to market conditions and stock-price levels. An existing buyback (¥400 million, up to 50,000 shares) announced in June 2026 remains ongoing. On the capex side, Kyowa Kogyo will invest ¥4.5 billion in a new factory on company-owned land, targeting production efficiency, factory layout optimization, and logistics improvement. Approximately ¥1.5 billion will be funded through a national subsidy, reducing the net capex burden.

The company states it will pursue both growth investment and appropriate shareholder returns in tandem, focusing on long-term business stability, employment security, and sustainable enterprise value. No specific ROE, margin, or payout-ratio target is disclosed in this update.
